recap.text: Ripper Wonton hosts a panel with Princess D'nadia, Manasa, Tucker, Hekla, and two guests. Donut spends half an hour calling Tucker Butler on air. The Skull Empire fires on a trailer and takes Manasa. Ripper reads Prince Stalwart's statement and notes that the Valtay took Stalwart's yacht apart. Ripper closes the show by rolling tape of Manasa singing.

Odette shows three faces for the choice of an adjutant. Donut picks Ripper because he is adorable. The barefoot one asks if any of them are qualified, and Odette tells the galaxy Ripper has short legs.

Ripper Wonton and crawl historian Sydnee Iglacia air without filters from a journalist barge in Earth orbit. Sydnee says a nine-tier attack happened before, starting with control of the tunnels and followed by A Parade of Horribles. Every monitor in the studio goes to a star field.

beats.headline: Danger Zone, with two new guests
beats.text: Welcome back, folks. On the panel tonight: Princess D'nadia, Manasa, Tucker, Hekla, and the two everybody in this galaxy has been waiting to get in a chair. Tucker opens with a crack about letting a pet sit on the panel, and the cat spends the next half hour taking him apart on air and calling him Butler, and I put my head down on the table so nobody sees me laugh, because it was funny and because he had it coming. Then the barefoot one starts talking about revolution inside the Skull Empire, and when Tucker tries to cut in I tell him to stop and let him finish, because a guest of mine gets to finish a sentence.
beats.gist: Ripper Wonton hosts a panel where a cat calls Tucker Butler.

beats.headline: The show goes dark
beats.text: And then the Skull Empire answers my guest by firing on a trailer, and they take Manasa, who had swapped trailers with my guests and was nobody's enemy and was not even the target. I hand the room to the audience questions while I find out what happened. Then we come back and I read Prince Stalwart's statement out on air, because that is the job, and then I say what I think of it, because that is also the job. By the time I finish saying it the Valtay have taken his yacht apart, with his mother and his disgraced brother rumoured aboard and Stalwart himself not, and folks, none of this is entertainment any more.
beats.gist: Ripper Wonton reads Prince Stalwart's statement on air after the Skull Empire fires on a trailer.

beats.headline: He closes with Manasa singing
beats.text: We are out of time and I am not doing a comedy sting tonight. Roll the tape of Manasa singing. All of it. Goodnight, folks.
beats.gist: Ripper Wonton closes the show by rolling a tape of Manasa singing.

beats.headline: One of the names on the adjutant list
beats.text: Odette puts three faces up for the two of them to choose an adjutant from, and one of them is mine. The cat takes one look and picks me because I am adorable, which is the correct reason. Then the barefoot one says wait, and asks whether any of us is qualified, and Odette tells the whole galaxy I have short legs. Either way, folks. I am flattered.
beats.gist: Odette shows three faces for an adjutant; the cat picks Ripper Wonton because he is adorable.

beats.headline: A historian, one on one
beats.text: No roundtable tonight, folks. Just me and Sydnee Iglacia, crawl historian, a trillion copies sold. I am stuck in Earth orbit on a journalist barge the OIAN run now, and they let us air without the filters, which I will take. Sydnee says the nine-tier attack has happened before. The first attack was control of the tunnels. The second has a name in the old histories: A Parade of Horribles. Then every monitor in the studio goes to a star field. We'll record it, friend.
beats.gist: Ripper Wonton and historian Sydnee Iglacia air without filters from a journalist barge in Earth orbit.
